{{Quote|I'll prepare our ''surprise'' for the Jedi&hellip; to make sure it's done right! The Jedi will be too busy mourning their lost comrade to realize their own doom will be sealed&hellip; as soon as the funeral pyre ignites our device!|The Weequay agent|<ref name="Sabotage (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.38|Sabotage (comic story)}}</ref>}}
This '''Weequay agent''' served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Along with [[Unidentified Weequay agent 2|two]] [[Unidentified Weequay agent 3|other]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] agents, who were his subordinates, he infiltrated a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Unidentified Coruscant funeral firm|funeral firm]] with forged credentials in an attempt to sabotage the [[Funeral of Halsey|funeral]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]].
